description: Add a retired: field (the version and why) to Defk.Errors registry entries, move the five codes retired before 0.1.0 (comment at lib/defk/errors.ex: bitwise, module-attribute, read-only-array, tuple-return-call, array-accumulator) into the registry as retired, and print retired codes in docs/compile-errors.md (a Retired section; the footer anchors stay). Commit test/stability/codes.txt: every code released so far. A test checks: every code in the file is in the registry (active or retired); a retired code is never raised (err! with a retired literal fails at compile, as unknown codes do now); a new code may be added (the file grows at release time). Regenerate the generated docs (docs/agents/generated-docs.md). Done when the test runs in mix ci and the catalogue shows the retired codes.
title: Stability: error code ledger with retired codes in the catalogue
